scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “Étale covers with a prescribed exterior sheet” (preprints/Etale-covers-with-a-prescribed-exterior-sheet-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 019 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 713430a73f1530f5), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 1-2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For the fixed disks and exterior above, there is a smooth proper connected curve Y/k̄ and a finite étale surjective morphism g : Y → X such that: (i) a connected component of g−1(U) maps isomorphically to U; (ii) for every i, every connected component of g−1(Vi) maps to Vi with degree divisible by p. 1 Here the inverse images and the degrees of their components refer to the induced finite étale analytic maps. The disks are the prescribed Vi; they are not shrunk in the conclusion.
